utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still happening, right? I just want to confirm before I show up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, it’s still happening—please come by. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. I’ll plan to stop by, and let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I act.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have the repair drive details yet, Hana—if you share what you’ve got, I can help keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t have any details yet either, so let’s wait until we do and then we can sort them carefully.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m ready to help coordinate the repair drive. Tell me what you need covered first, and I’ll get it organized.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rosa — I usually end up joining late, but I can help with the supplies list and checking in with volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be a huge help, Dane — let’s start with the supplies list, then I’ll line up the volunteer check-ins around it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive going on—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand with the small fixes—tools, a ladder, or whatever’s needed. Just point me to the first job.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus—could you start with the squeaky gate by the front walk? I’ve only heard second-hand, but that sounded like the first thing they wanted fixed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That’s kind of you, Leo. I could use help sorting donations and loading the bigger items.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Sam — can you help by checking the donation list and then handing out the repair kits?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’ve already got a few neighbors interested — want me to pass your name along too?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please pass my name along. I’d appreciate knowing the time and place so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll let you know as soon as I have the time and place, and I’ll pass your name along right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are still dropping things off by the community hall — seems like it’s picking up nicely.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, good to hear. I meant to stop by and donate, but I’ve been a bit all over the place lately.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No worries at all — you can still swing by later this week; they’re keeping the drop-off going. If you want, I can remind you when the hall is open.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m thinking late afternoon would be safest, after pickup. I just want to make sure we don’t run into school traffic or get in anyone’s way.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late afternoon sounds good to me—I can work around pickup and help keep it clear of school traffic. Just send me the time and I’ll plan for it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Ira — much appreciated. If you hear anything, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right — I might’ve missed the latest details, but I’m happy to help if you fill me in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Noah — it’s just a small neighborhood repair drive to help folks with minor fixes. I can tell you the details if you want to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m going to spread the word about the repair drive and see who can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you want me to bring tools, or should I just help sort the repair list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Bring the tools if you can, and I’ll sort the repair list with you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can bring the tools. What time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d be happy to help, but I’m a bit cautious about the logistics—what exactly do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help if the plan is clear—where and when do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s still on — I’m ready to help out with tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to make sure. I’ll let you know if I need those tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple and set a clear plan for the repair drive. I’m happy to help if you tell me what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Eli — the first stop should be the porch light at Maple and 3rd, then the loose gate latch by the community garden.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. I’ll start with the porch light at Maple and 3rd, then head to the gate latch by the community garden.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll repeat the repair drive plans to the neighbors and make sure everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m planning to swing by the repair drive later and see what they need. If you want, I can let you know when I’m heading over.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’d be great, Quinn—thanks. Just let me know when you’re heading over and I’ll spread the word if needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll text you as soon as I’m heading over, and you can pass it along if anyone else wants to join.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’m here—how can I help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries at all—thanks for coming. Could you help sort the donated tools and set them by the tables?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely—I can do that. I’ll sort the donated tools and get them set by the tables.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it quiet for now.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s okay — I’ll keep it quiet. Just let me know what works for you.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, it’s still happening — please come by. We’re keeping it going as planned.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — could you bring a drill and some screws, and maybe help patch the loose fence panel?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring a drill and some screws, and I can help patch the fence panel too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we already have and what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That’d be great, thanks—just let me know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely — folks have been pretty generous so far. If you want, I can pass along the latest details when I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help out. What still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll make a quick inventory and get back to you with the missing items.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thank you, Rey — I’m a bit scattered today, but I think we mostly need tools, a few volunteers, and maybe someone to sort the donation boxes. Could you help me figure out the list?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely — I can help sort the list and keep it simple. Let’s start with tools, volunteers, and donation boxes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest details, but I’m happy to help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah. I’ll check the latest details first and then let you know exactly what’s needed.
